# WSL2-enable-eBPF

> A pinned x86-64 WSL2 kernel profile and build guide for eBPF observability,
> enforcement, and container networking, with validation and upstream update tooling.

Read the agent guide and repository map first. Source code and the source lock
are authoritative. Linux configuration validation, kernel compilation, WSL boot,
and workload validation are separate checks. Relative links refer to this same
repository revision. Exclude the upstream kernel submodule, Git metadata, caches,
build artifacts, and local environment files from default indexing.

## Documentation

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): editing rules, indexing boundaries, source/configuration invariants, and verification commands.
- [Repository map](docs/REPOSITORY_MAP.md): file responsibilities, build/update flows, and investigation entry points.
- [Setup guide](README.md): prerequisites, pinned source initialization, build/install, rollback, and runtime/workload checks.
- [Kernel option reference](KERNEL_CONFIG_EXPLAINED.md): requested kernel symbols, dependencies, and upstream references.

## Source and automation

- [Source lock](kernel-version.env): current release, immutable commit, and upstream URL.
- [Submodule declaration](.gitmodules): registered upstream source path and tracking series.
- [Kernel profile](ebpf-kernel.config): requested eBPF, enforcement, networking, and container options.
- [Configuration validation](scripts/check-config.py): required-value and LSM checks.
- [Stable release updater](scripts/update-kernel.py): same-series numeric tag selection and source-pin updates.
- [Update PR description](scripts/write-update-pr-body.py): release metadata and validation-run link for automated PRs.
- [Validation workflow](.github/workflows/validate.yml): local checks and Linux Kconfig resolution.
- [Scheduled updater](.github/workflows/update-kernel.yml): weekly/manual checks and validated update pull requests.
- [OBI Compose example](examples/compose.yaml): Docker Engine inside WSL and an optional HTTP smoke workload.

- [Release build](scripts/build-release.sh): compile and package binaries and source archives.
- [Windows installer](scripts/Install-WslEbpfKernel.ps1): verified release downloads and backed-up configuration updates.
- [Release workflow](.github/workflows/release.yml): version-tag builds and draft releases.

## Optional

- [Complete documentation bundle](llms-full.txt): generated project docs in one file; use instead of indexing the same pages twice.
- [Config regression tests](tests/test_check_config.py): missing/disabled options, LSM activation, and input validation.
- [Release selection tests](tests/test_update_kernel.py): stable-series boundaries, numeric ordering, peeled tags, and immutable pins.
